approval_note: 2026-09-08 brief drafted after the maintainer asked what the spec state was and whether anything was forgotten. It was: model-grounded-detection is 16/16 complete and its arbiter is measured at 86.7% pair-correct / 6.7% leak, but the model layer has ZERO production callers -- ousast scan does not use it, so the feature is complete and unshipped at once. That is a scope gap in the predecessor (it had no task saying 'make this reachable', and its byte-identical-gates requirement is satisfied precisely because nothing is wired). This spec covers scan integration, whole-repo scanning against known vulnerable repositories, the deferred memory-family decision, and records the pipeline, ops and corpus work delivered outside any spec. Not approved; requirements not generated. ; 2026-09-08 requirements generated at the maintainer's direction ('we follow the spec and build integration afterwards'). ; 2026-09-09 requirements approved and design generated ('let us continue with these'): the model layer joins as one stage inside MAP beside the obligations checker, one CPG per scan, regions from entry points, a total budget rather than a per-region cap. Phase 2 (the first run on a pinned real repository) can invalidate the rest and comes before shipping. ; 2026-09-09 tasks approved by the maintainer ('approve the tasks and start group 1'); implementing group 1 (regions, driver, MAP stage).
